---
name: NURA Documentation
description: Documentation is the product source of truth
applyTo: "docs/**,STATE.md"
---

- Treat `docs/` as the specification and `STATE.md` as current project state.
- Do not silently resolve ambiguity between documentation and code; ask the user.
- Keep product terminology consistent with `docs/tone-of-voice.md`.
- Do not change canonical requirements merely to match existing code.
